name: Lucky Harvest Co., Ltd.
summary: Lucky Harvest Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of precision stamping dies and structural metal parts in China and internationally. The company's products include progressive, transfer, and multiset tools for production of automobile metal structural parts and components; auto parts systems, such as body, battery, electronic, seating, new energy, and heat exchanger systems; chassis system components; photovoltaic inverters; energy storage cabinets; CNC sheet metal parts for application in server cases, including communication equipment functional plug boxes or cabinets, charging pile shells, aerospace, and medical equipment, as well as office and electronic…
